tagline: Release testing for teams who cannot afford a bad Monday morning
intro: We test the customer journeys in banking, insurance and healthcare software before every release. A named lead runs your account, works to your release calendar and signs off each release with a written report.
audience: Product and engineering teams at banks, insurers, healthcare providers and public services across the north-east United States, usually with a monthly or quarterly release cycle.
pricing_note: An annual agreement priced per product and per release, with a fixed number of testing days for each. Extra days are billed at an agreed daily rate.

services.title: Release assurance
services.description: A named lead plans testing against your release calendar, runs the agreed journeys before each release and signs off with a written report.

services.title: Regression programmes
services.description: We build and maintain the set of journeys that must work every time, and run them on every release candidate you send us.

services.title: Acceptance testing support
services.description: We prepare and run user acceptance testing with your business teams, so new features are checked by the people who will use them.

services.title: Accessibility checks
services.description: Your core journeys completed with keyboards and screen readers, with findings mapped to the accessibility standards you report against.

process.title: Agree the scope
process.description: We agree which journeys matter, on which devices and browsers, and what has to be true before a release is cleared. All of it written down.

process.title: Test each release
process.description: Our testers work through every agreed journey on the release candidate, log findings in your tracker and keep you updated daily.

process.title: Sign off in writing
process.description: Before the release goes out you receive a report listing what was tested, what was found, what was fixed and what remains open.

proof.text: The sign-off report has become part of our change approval board pack.
